profile.headline: Software Engineer III | AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner | Microsoft Azure Certified Data Science Associate
profile.summary:
🔍 About Me
As a seasoned software engineer with certifications in both Azure and AWS, I specialize in designing and implementing applications using infrastructure as code with Python, and building web applications with React and TypeScript.
I have also built and maintained data warehouses and integrated data across various systems being the main point of contact for several business units, deployed machine learning models accessible from an API, and built and supported asynchronous distributed systems.

Above all, I am a lifelong learner; which serves me well in this industry and in life.

🌐 Connect with Me
I'm always eager to connect with like-minded professionals and enthusiasts in tech and elsewhere. 

Whether you're facing a technical challenge, exploring new solutions, or just want to chat, feel free to reach out.


🔧 Technical Toolkit 

Coding
*********************

Python
HTML
JS
TypeScript
React
Next
SQL
C#
Linq
Java 

AWS
*********************

CDK - defining infrastructure as code (python)
S3 - structured object storage 
Lambda - serverless compute service
DynamoDB - nosql db
EC2 - compute capacity
Route 53 - DNS set up
SQS - queue service
SNS - pub/sub messaging service
KMS - encryption
IAM - management of enabling access for services and resources

Data Analytics and Data Science
*********************

SSIS - ETL processes
SSAS - data warehouses/datacubes
Azure Machine Learning - deployed models accessible from the web via an API

Other Technologies
********************

Git - version-control system for tracking changes in source code
Bitbucket - version-control
Git Actions - automation scripts (CI/CD) that run directly on GitHub.
Azure DevOps - similar to git actions
GitHub - version control and collaboration, hosting Git repositories..

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Played a large role in the creation and design of a solution that has managed millions of dollars and saved the need to hire three full time employees, saving thousands of hours of tedious work and giving that time back to existing employees
AWS CDK with python - Infrastructure as Code for AWS resource deployment, building out event-driven architecture, working with APIs, etc.
Work with queues on-prem and in AWS.
Lots of exposure to wrangling data systems utilizing Python, SSIS, C#, AWS, Mulesoft.
Creation of git action pipeline that automates deployments of Dash enterprise web applications
CI/CD pipelines in git actions and azure pipelines
Maintenance and building out of queues/topics (IBM, AWS SQS)

positions.title: Data Engineer/Data Warehouse Manager
positions.locationName: West Des Moines, Iowa, United States
positions.description:
- Python for geospatial analysis; asset metadata; xml data; data profiling; data migration; report generation; ad hoc reports
Worked with C#/ASP.NET MVC, LINQ, and Kendo for developing data visualizations
- Management of data warehouse environment - developing, processing, and deploying to an analysis services instance.
- Experience managing/using data access tools Pyramid Analytics, Excel, BI Query, Power BI
- Overseeing daily back ups of ~100 databases.
- SSIS packages/deployment for a data warehouse environment. 
- Management of ETL processes/data pipelines for large-scale data sources of varying formats 
- Creation of databases and data warehouses as need arises.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) · Powershell · Data Engineering · Data Analysis · Python (Programming Language) · SQL · Agile Methodologies · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS) · Data Warehousing · Git · Data Modeling · Web Design

positions.title: Adult Services Librarian
positions.description:
Collected statistics on 15 electronic resources
Compared tens of thousands of e-content in entity Resolution to determine overlap
- standardized names
- cleaned up data
- Analyzed three years of data to see patterns in usage of material
- Generated other reports as needed
- Collected statistics from digitized Newspapers with Google Analytics
- Curated fiction for e-content for Iowa Bridges Consortium 
- Analyzed three years of incident reports to determine areas of the library prone to incidents
- Set up for Mainstream Living community monthly movie screening events; viewing events appropriate for adults who are neurodivergent and/or have an intellectual disability
positions.insights: Skills: Data Integration · SQL · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Data Analysis · Library Systems
